name: Pizzeria da Giorgio
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria da Giorgio in Tirol**

Welcome to **Pizzeria da Giorgio** in the heart of **Tirol**! Here, authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Enjoy freshly baked **Pizza Napoletana**, crispy **Calzones**, and delicious **Pasta** made with love.

Our menu features classic dishes like **Margherita**, **Diavola**, and **Quattro Formaggi**, as well as seasonal specialties. Don’t miss our homemade **Tiramisu** or a glass of fine Italian wine to complete your meal.

Whether you're craving a quick lunch or a cozy dinner, **Pizzeria da Giorgio** offers a warm, inviting atmosphere. Come taste the sun of Italy in the heart of **Tirol**!
